subject.title: [Security] Sensitive credential leakage in telemetry headers for auto-reply webhooks

question: Should this report move to private GitHub Security Advisory triage for validation of the alleged external webhook credential disclosure?
rationale: The issue alleges credential exfiltration but lacks a verified current-main reproduction; deciding the disclosure channel and the appropriate evidence request is a security-boundary judgment.

options.title: Validate privately
options.body: Ask for a minimal redacted reproduction, affected version, webhook configuration, and captured outbound payload through the private security-reporting path before assigning a code fix.

options.title: Request public clarification
options.body: Keep the issue public only if maintainers determine that the missing data can be requested without exposing a potentially exploitable path.

recommendation.title: Validate privately
recommendation.body: Ask for a minimal redacted reproduction, affected version, webhook configuration, and captured outbound payload through the private security-reporting path before assigning a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository policy identifies security and safe defaults as an active project priority, but code-area ownership remains unconfirmed.
